Thanks for looping me in — quick checklist so we’re aligned on what AWS will expect for ACE submission and for our internal readiness. I’ll own the AWS-facing submission.

1) Administrative / commercial

   - Bill-to / SOW placeholder (Aisha to confirm billing contact)

2) Technical artifacts (please share):
   - AWS account IDs for co-sell tagging (list preferred accounts; dev/prod)
   - High-level architecture diagram showing where Redwood inference sits (public doc or redacted)
   - Expected throughput and latency SLOs (we have the 15M tokens/day note)

3) Security/compliance (quick items to attach)
   - SOC2 summary or questionnaire response (if available)
   - Network access requirements (VPN, IP allowlists)

4) Timeline & owner commitments
   - ACE submission: by 2026-10-02 (target) — I’ll submit once we have account IDs and bill-to
   - Pilot enablement: provisioning & test harness by 2026-11-10

Immediate ask for Stratus: please upload the account IDs and confirm billing contact by EOD 2026-09-30. I’ve also added a few inline notes in the MAP doc.
